name: risk-spike
context_rationale: Interactive blocking gate: writes and runs throwaway proof code, needs credentials/device access, and on failure requires a human discussion of a risk-free fallback before re-spiking — depends on the live slice session.
summary: In-loop spike gate with TWO modes (the crown jewel is split, not diluted). FEASIBILITY (default, step-0, before /design-slice): reads the picked candidate's blocking assumptions from candidates.json and proves each with throwaway code on real environments; spawns the field-recon subagent to survey current platform reality first; all proven -> /design-slice, any FAILED -> candidate blocked until a fallback is re-spiked; verdicts recorded back into candidates.json + the risk ledger. DESIGN (--mode design, post-synthesis, after /design-slice's tournament): reads the synthesized design.json's pending decidable_disagreements + must-verify cross-domain invariants and lets REALITY adjudicate the tournament, writing verdicts back into design.json; all GO -> /critique, any NO-GO -> back to /design-slice to re-synthesize (the premise already passed feasibility).

name: commit-slice
context_rationale: Generates commit messages from vault files on disk; no interactive main-thread context needed except for the --merge/--push confirmation gates which are explicit checkpoints.
summary: Generates an audit-grade conventional commit message for a just-completed slice by reading vault artifacts (mission-brief.json, build-log.json, validation.json, reflection.json, ADRs). Dispatches message rendering to a Haiku subagent for cost efficiency. Supports three mutually exclusive execution modes: --merge, --push, and --sync-after-pr. Default mode generates and displays the message only.

name: pulse
context_rationale: Read-only vault summarization from files on disk; all required state is in vault files and git state, no main-thread conversation context needed.
summary: Scans the AI SDLC vault and produces a compact macro-state summary covering active slice stage, risk exposure, regression health, Critic calibration status, top lessons, and recommended next action. Read-only — never modifies vault files. Dispatches summary text rendering to a Haiku subagent for cost efficiency. Supports three modes: default, --brief, and --full.

name: user-test
context_rationale: Interactive: requires live user participation, real-time session facilitation, and post-session Q&A to capture observations; cannot run as a headless subagent.
summary: Runs a real-user validation gate using mockup, prototype, or working slice before /design-slice. Helps prepare the artifact, suggests behavior-focused observation questions, frames the test session protocol, and captures findings in a structured vault document. Updates risk-register.json with any new risks surfaced by user behavior via scripts.lib.vault_edit append (SVW-1). Applies to B2C and user-facing projects.
